name: personal-data
description: Data science and analytics toolkit for the ActBlue data team. Front-door router (ab), end-to-end warehouse analysis with live read-only Redshift execution and QA gates (analyze), causal design + power (experiment-design), code artifact generation (code-draft), rubric-based code review (data-code-review + fresh-context data-code-reviewer agent), executive Q&A prep (exec-qa-prep), quarterly staged dictionary refresh (dictionary-refresh), and dispatchable agents (warehouse-analyst incl. verify mode, lookml-grounder). Covers Redshift SQL, Python, dbt, and LookML workflows.
